name: code_status
description: Report the code index state of the calling session's own repo: the last analyze run (phase, result indexed|up-to-date|incomplete|failed, last log line, log path), live readiness (ready|building|interrupted|inconsistent|missing; building = an analyze is live, including one rewriting an existing index, which is never served meanwhile; interrupted = marked incomplete with no analyze running; inconsistent = the gitnexus registry or the fleet record of its last build names a different commit than meta.json, with the reason in inconsistency), the indexed commit, autoReindexPaused (a failed automatic run that paused automatic rebuilds until code_reindex), and injectedBlockFiles / injectedBlockWarning (agent docs still holding a gitnexus block from an earlier plain analyze run). Only the gitnexus provider is supported: provider none fails with E-CODE-INTEL-DISABLED, any other provider gets {outcome: "not-started", reason: "provider-not-supported", provider, indexedCommit: null} instead of gitnexus readiness. Scope: always the calling session's own repo -- a member session uses its registered work folder; any other session uses the first MCP client root (roots/list) inside a git repository with an origin remote, as that repository's top level -- the same repository its kb_* tools use -- or the fleet server's working folder when the client offers no roots. Extension for code tools only: when roots are offered and none has an origin remote, the first offered git repository is used (kb_* tools then fail with E-SELF-NO-REMOTE). There is no repo/path scope argument. Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER or E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO when that folder is missing or is not a git repository, E-CODE-INDEX-NOT-READY when it has no usable code index yet (a missing or interrupted index gets a build requested automatically -- retry shortly) or the index is still building (that error's text and structuredContent carry retry_after_ms -- wait that long once, retry once, then fall back; never poll code_status in a loop -- plus retry_will_help and, while an analyze runs, its progress), and E-CODE-INTEL-DISABLED when code intelligence is off (each with a one-line remediation).
